text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The final race of the year, the Arima<n>Kinen, is about
to start soon!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Fan
text_block_list.text:
I already know the Empress is going<n>to win this
year's race! I can feel it in<n>my gut!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
The lineup this year really is<n>something... I wonder
who's gonna<n>win?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Dober...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Expectations are high here at the<n>Arima Kinen. I can
feel the tension in<n>the venue even from here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
As a member of the Mejiro family, I<n>can't afford to
embarrass myself in<n>front of Air Groove and the
other<n>senior racers, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Obviously. Later!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'll be back in a bit!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Incredible! ☆ Everyone looks<n>so marvelous
today! ★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Incredible! ☆ Everyone looks<n>so marvelous
today! ★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure this race will be absolutely<n>marvelous! ☆
My heart is pounding<n>with excitement! ★

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone's in excellent form! Senior<n>racers are
really on an entirely<n>different level!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (But still, the most spectacular racer<n>out here is...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Thank you all for your support.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Air Groove! Her aura is<n>breathtaking!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Good seeing you here, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(It's so hard to breathe with her<n>standing so close!
I feel like I'm<n>getting crushed by her presence
alone!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
All of the racers here today—including<n>you—are
distinguished contenders.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Be careful not to get swept up in<n>everything too
easily.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I won't!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(She's right. I can't afford to be<n>overwhelmed now.
I have to be ready<n>to take everyone on—even Air
Groove—at my very best!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I look forward to running with you!
